claim_ceiling: Numerical sensitivity analysis of distinct angular-mean conventions; no universal active-matter phase-transition claim and no biological or intelligence claim

source.title: Absence of O(2) symmetry in the Vicsek model
source.exact_equation: theta_i(t+dt) = atan(mean_j sin(theta_j) / mean_j cos(theta_j)) + Xi_i, modulo 2pi
source.adaptive_phase_protocol: phi(t) = phi_bar - arithmetic_mean_i(theta_i(t)); apply to all headings before calculating velocities and the next alignment update
source.author_reported_conclusion: The principal-value arctan-ratio update depends on the global phase reference; under adaptive phase reference phi_bar=pi, the paper reports that clear flocking order does not develop in the studied regime. The authors separately report their arithmetic-mean-angle variant as phase-invariant.
source.important_math_distinction: atan(sum_sin/sum_cos) is not equal to atan2(sum_sin,sum_cos) in quadrants II and III. atan2 is the quadrant-correct complex-argument/circular-mean convention. The paper's scalar arithmetic-mean variant is a third distinct rule and is not the same as atan2.

source_profile.phase_mean: Arithmetic mean of principal heading representatives; not a circular mean
source_profile.implementation_status: Source parameters and operation order pinned from paper; exact random seeds, sampling/averaging windows, and source implementation commit still require admission for a full numerical reproduction.

model_heading_mean_variants.meaning: Quadrant-correct circular mean / complex argument; rotationally equivariant under common phase shifts when neighbourhood structure is held fixed.
Principal-value ratio formula discussed in Takahashi et al. (2026); identifies directions separated by pi and can introduce branch-cut dependence.

implementation.implemented_adaptive_phase_operation: apply_adaptive_global_phase_shift(target_phase_rad) maps headings into (-pi,pi], calculates their arithmetic mean, and adds target_phase - mean to every heading without wrapping the shifted headings before the next update.
implementation.receipts: VicsekMetrics and VicsekClusterGeometryReport record heading_mean, so the angle convention travels with every result.

minimal_known_truth_controls.acceptance: Atan2 self-only alignment preserves the polar order under a common phase shift.
Principal-value ratio folds the self-aligned directions across a pi branch and changes the order parameter without inter-particle interactions.

minimal_known_truth_controls.expected_rule: Atan2 output shifts by pi; principal-value ratio maps both inputs to the same tangent branch.

metamorphic_suite.caveat: The test keeps the cluster far from the periodic boundary; it tests local finite-domain rotation equivariance, not continuous rotational symmetry of a square torus under arbitrary whole-domain rotations.

source_reproduction_gates: Recover exact source initial-state RNG law and random seed(s).
Run the exact N=1600, L=8, v=0.01, r=0.1, dt=1, eta=0.75, 10,000-step profile.
Run both fixed phase and adaptive phase target values 0 and pi using the paper's order of operations.
Preserve the arctan-ratio and scalar arithmetic-mean models as separate variants; do not substitute atan2 for either.
Report order parameter time series, stationary-window averaging, seed-level uncertainty and phase-shift sensitivity.
Check whether any phase-dependent behavior is due to branch-cut implementation, adaptive coordinate convention, or finite-size stochasticity.
Do not infer the paper's phase-transition conclusion from the four-particle unit test.
